name: Tabs multiply
oneLiner: a glass browser window drifts in 3D while tabs multiply across its top faster and faster, squeezing until only their icons show and the counter climbs, a cursor clicks the brand's tab, every other tab snaps shut in a wave, the count falls to 1 and the brand's tab widens over its real page
say: when the speaker says 'I had twenty tabs open' or 'stop juggling ten tools': the tabs pile up through the problem, the click and the collapse land on 'now I just use this one'
